name: QWave
tagline: Detects malicious manipulation hidden in audio by combining signal analysis with quantum-kernel classification.

awards: Best Digital Forensics Related Hack - Cipher Tech Solutions

problem: Malicious audio manipulation can hide in natural-looking noise.
solution: Classifies audio as clean, natural noise or manipulated using spectral features and a simulated quantum feature map, with email alerts.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a tampered file and see it flagged.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Digital Forensics Related Hack - Cipher Tech Solutions” among 223 submissions.

lessons: Pair a new technique with a concrete forensics use.
